sloka: महति एषा हि ते सिद्धिर् एष च अभ्युदयो महान् ।एष स्वर्गस्य मार्गः च यद् एनम् अनुगच्चसि ॥२-४०-२६॥
transliteration: mahati eṣā hi te siddhir eṣa ca abhyudayo mahān ।eṣa svargasya mārgaḥ ca yad enam anugaccasi ॥2-40-26॥

translations.english: The very fact that you are following Rama is a great achievement and a great fortune for you. This, in fact, is the way to heaven.
